findings.kind: test-quality (structural cell does not detect what it claims to)
findings.title: cell-budget-census.test.ts's ungrantedHeavyCells detector only recognizes a locally-named `scan(` helper called 2+ times; it misses a bare .analyze() call and a single-scan cell, so three real files with no sign-in floor and no budget go unflagged
findings.evidence: apps/web/e2e/cell-budget-census.test.ts's own detector: `const SCAN_CALL = /\bscan\(/g;` (only matches a call literally named `scan(`) and `if (scans >= 2 && !DECLARES_BUDGET.test(body)) offenders++;` (requires 2+). Verified live against the real tree: `money-input.spec.ts` (one `new AxeBuilder({ page }).withTags(WCAG_TAGS).analyze()` at line 30, no `signIn`/`signInTo` import at all), `interview-walk.spec.ts` (its "client interview completes every tracked segment..." cell, line 232, signs in through a locally-defined `establishSession(page)` that is NOT the shared `signIn`/`signInTo` helper and never calls `grantCellBudget`), and `signup-confirm-pending.spec.ts` (line 92, no sign-in at all) each run a real `AxeBuilder.analyze()` pass with zero automatic CELL_BUDGET.signIn floor and zero `test.setTimeout`/`cellBudgetMs`/`grantCellBudget` call anywhere in the file (`grep -c "test.setTimeout\|grantCellBudget\|cellBudgetMs"` = 0 for all three). CELL_BUDGET's own doc comment in helpers.ts measures a single `AxeBuilder.analyze()` at up to 33s under host load against a flat 30s Playwright default — exactly the timeout-flake mechanism #864 exists to close — yet these three cells sit on the bare 30s default today, on `main` as landed by this lane, and the census that is supposed to hold #864's whole brief ("A census... shows every spec file that signs in, polls or scans calls the budget helper") reports green while they exist.
findings.required_fix: Broaden the detector to a generic pattern (any `new AxeBuilder(` / `.analyze(` call, not only a call to a helper literally named `scan(`) and drop the '>=2' floor to '>=1' for a file with no automatic sign-in grant, since CELL_BUDGET's own measurement shows a single scan can already exceed the flat default under load; then give money-input.spec.ts, interview-walk.spec.ts and signup-confirm-pending.spec.ts (and `establishSession` in interview-walk.spec.ts, which is a second sign-in shape the census's `callsSharedSignIn` does not recognize) their own `test.setTimeout(cellBudgetMs({ scans: 1 }))`/`grantCellBudget` calls the same way checkout-gate-walk.spec.ts was fixed.
